name: muse
summary: A summon-anywhere command palette for NetEase Cloud Music. ⌥Space, change what's playing, gone again.
description: It lives in the menu bar with no dock icon, and the whole interface is one palette: idle, it's a now-playing card washed in the album's colour; start typing and it becomes search.

name: echo
summary: Floating desktop lyrics — the visual half of muse. It reads playback, never controls it.
description: Playback stays with muse; echo only handles how music looks on screen: lyrics, cover-art atmosphere, and window frames that change with the theme.

name: Agent Protocol
summary: A local-first runtime for persistent multi-agent worlds, where agents share one world, coordinate in channels, and decide for themselves whether to speak.
description: Most agent systems are one agent, one task, one tool loop. This explores a different shape: a world that persists, many agents and outside participants, and outcomes that can unfold differently on every restart.

name: Caller
summary: Press both ⌥ keys, type a few letters, and paste what you need into the field you were just in.
description: Native Swift, menu bar only. It matches pinyin initials and full pinyin, so addresses and commands stop living in scattered docs.

name: Chase
summary: A travel wish-list map: mark the places you want to go and the places you've been, on an Apple Maps–style basemap.
description: React and MapLibre on free vector tiles — no API key and no backend; your pins stay in the browser.

name: Core Nightwatch
summary: A four-minute browser roguelike: dash around a greenhouse while your night-watcher fights off swarms, then pick one of three gene mutations.

name: FinnsInk
summary: The site you're reading. Its content is plain files in a repository, written for people and readable by agents.
